title: Reaching GA requires UHG to productize Fabric with defined capabilities, approved patterns, automation, embedded governance, and a consumable service experience
service_scope_activities: Clarify Fabric workloads and users it is intended to serve
Define how Fabric complements Databricks, Snowflake, Power BI, and enterprise services
Specify which capabilities are offered centrally versus owned by consuming teams
architecture_activities: Design workspace, environment, capacity, and lifecycle design
Design interoperability, data sharing, and workload placement standards
delivery_activities: Define monitoring, telemetry, and operational processes
governance_activities: Integrate security, lineage, classification, and policy controls
Document support, service levels, financial management, and chargeback
adoption_activities: Establish intake, onboarding, documentation, training, reusable products, and operational handoff
Define the path to self-service onboarding
Create foundational documentation, training, and reusable assets
framing_statement: Our solution aligns architecture, automation, governance, operations, and adoption from the start so General Availability is designed into the platform rather than added after the technology is deployed
risk_strip_heading: KEY RISKS IF NOT DONE RIGHT
isolation_risk: Fabric becomes just an additional platform
service_scope_heading: Define the platform proposition & service catalog
